concept: Listening to someone else's idea, even when you think yours is better
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character listens to a friend's different idea instead of insisting on their own, and it turns out well
exercise.reflection_prompt: What did the character learn by listening instead of insisting?
exercise.practice: Student practices a short roleplay of really listening to a different idea from the mentor persona

assessment.success_marker: student can restate the other idea accurately after listening, not just wait for their turn to talk
